colosseum.name: Colosseum
colosseum.price_text: €18 combined ticket with Roman Forum and Palatine Hill · EU 18–25 reduced · under 18 free
colosseum.hours: Daily roughly 08:30–19:00; closing time varies by season — check on the day
colosseum.tip: Book a timed entry online and go at opening; the combined ticket also covers the Forum and Palatine.
colosseum.best: First thing in the morning; spring and autumn

st-peters.name: St. Peter's Basilica
st-peters.price_text: Free entry · dome climb costs extra (check on the day)
st-peters.hours: Basilica roughly 07:00–19:00; dress code enforced — check on the day
st-peters.tip: Cover shoulders and knees, and arrive before 09:00 to avoid the long security queue.

pantheon.name: Pantheon
pantheon.price_text: ≈ €5 entry — check current price on the day
pantheon.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–19:00; shorter hours on Sundays and holidays
pantheon.tip: Look up at the open oculus and go on a sunny day for the light beam.
pantheon.best: Midday for the light; any season

trevi.name: Trevi Fountain
trevi.tip: Come before 08:00 or after 22:00 — midday is packed shoulder to shoulder.

forum.name: Roman Forum
forum.price_text: €18 combined ticket with Colosseum and Palatine Hill
forum.tip: Enter from the Via della Salara Vecchia gate to skip the Colosseum queue.

vatican-museums.name: Vatican Museums
vatican-museums.price_text: ≈ €20 base ticket; online booking adds a fee — check on the day
vatican-museums.hours: Mon–Sat roughly 09:00–18:00; closed most Sundays — check on the day
vatican-museums.tip: Book the first slot online and head straight for the Sistine Chapel before the crowds build.

spanish-steps.name: Spanish Steps
spanish-steps.tip: Sitting on the steps is banned and fined — admire from the square below.

navona.name: Piazza Navona
navona.tip: Sit at the edge of Bernini's Fountain of the Four Rivers in the evening for the best light.

castel-sant-angelo.name: Castel Sant'Angelo
castel-sant-angelo.tip: Climb to the terrace for one of the best views over St. Peter's dome.

altare-patria.name: Altare della Patria
altare-patria.price_text: Free to the terrace level · panoramic lift costs extra
altare-patria.tip: Take the free stairs for a sweeping view over the Forum and rooftops.

santa-maria-maggiore.name: Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore
santa-maria-maggiore.price_text: Free entry · some chapels and museum charge
santa-maria-maggiore.hours: Daily roughly 07:00–18:30 — check on the day
santa-maria-maggiore.tip: Look up at the golden ceiling and the 5th-century mosaics in the nave.

caracalla.name: Baths of Caracalla
caracalla.hours: Tue–Sun roughly 09:00–18:00; closes earlier in winter
caracalla.tip: Huge and quiet — bring water and shade; summer evenings sometimes host opera.

apollo-daphne.name: Apollo and Daphne
apollo-daphne.price_text: Included in Galleria Borghese ticket ≈ €13 — book ahead
apollo-daphne.hours: Tue–Sun timed slots roughly 09:00–19:00; closed Monday
apollo-daphne.tip: Book a timed slot online; entry is limited and sells out days ahead.

bibliotheca-hertziana.name: Bibliotheca Hertziana
bibliotheca-hertziana.price_text: Research institute — not generally open to tourists; check on the day
bibliotheca-hertziana.hours: Weekday research hours only — check on the day
bibliotheca-hertziana.tip: This is a research library, not a sight — skip it unless you have a study appointment.

bioparco.name: Bioparco Zoo
bioparco.price_text: ≈ €16 adult · reduced for children — check on the day
bioparco.tip: Good for families with small kids; go in the morning when animals are active.

cinecitta-world.name: Cinecittà World
cinecitta-world.price_text: ≈ €30 day ticket — check on the day
cinecitta-world.hours: Seasonal; often weekends and holidays only — check on the day
cinecitta-world.tip: A film-themed theme park far outside the centre — allow a half day plus travel.

discobolus.name: Discobolus
discobolus.price_text: Included in Palazzo Massimo ticket ≈ €13 — check on the day
discobolus.tip: See the Roman marble copy in Palazzo Massimo alle Terme, near Termini.

ecstasy-teresa.name: Ecstasy of Saint Teresa
ecstasy-teresa.hours: Church roughly 07:00–12:00 and 16:00–19:00 — check on the day
ecstasy-teresa.tip: Bernini's sculpture sits in the Cornaro Chapel of Santa Maria della Vittoria; drop a coin for the lights.

fettuccine-papalina.name: Fettuccine alla Papalina
fettuccine-papalina.hours: Lunch and dinner at most trattorias — check on the day
fettuccine-papalina.tip: A creamy ham-and-peas pasta said to be named for a pope — try it in a Prati trattoria.

hadrians-villa.name: Hadrian's Villa
hadrians-villa.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–18:30; closes earlier in winter
hadrians-villa.tip: In Tivoli, about an hour from Rome — pair it with Villa d'Este and wear walking shoes.

laocoon.name: Laocoön and His Sons
laocoon.hours: Same as Vatican Museums — check on the day
laocoon.tip: In the Octagonal Court near the entrance — see it first before the one-way route sweeps you on.

luneur.name: Luneur
luneur.price_text: ≈ €20 ride pass — check on the day
luneur.hours: Seasonal; often afternoons and weekends — check on the day
luneur.tip: A small family amusement park in EUR, south of the centre — good with young children.

campo-de-fiori.name: Campo de' Fiori market
campo-de-fiori.price_text: Free to browse; food priced per item
campo-de-fiori.hours: Morning market Mon–Sat roughly 07:00–14:00; closed Sunday
campo-de-fiori.tip: Come before noon for produce and flowers; the square turns into bars at night.

gianicolo.name: Gianicolo viewpoint
gianicolo.tip: Walk up from Trastevere for the classic panorama over the domes at sunset.

trastevere-walk.name: Trastevere evening walk
trastevere-walk.tip: Wander the cobbled lanes off the main squares, then eat where the menu is short and in Italian.

golf-cart-tour.name: Golf-cart highlights tour
golf-cart-tour.price_text: ≈ €70–110 per person, 2–3 hours — check on the day
golf-cart-tour.tip: Good for a first day or hot afternoons; confirm what is included before booking.

monti-walk.name: Monti neighbourhood walk
monti-walk.tip: Vintage shops and small churches between the Colosseum and Termini — go on a weekday afternoon.

pincio-terrace.name: Pincio Terrace
pincio-terrace.hours: Park roughly 07:00–sunset — check on the day
pincio-terrace.tip: Above the Spanish Steps in Villa Borghese — the best free sunset view over Piazza del Popolo.
